assertion.text: Given a line-replacing snippet, the validator accepts a faithful merge and rejects variants that delete unrelated code, omit required snippet code, duplicate or reorder code, invent content, or leak a marker.

context.conventions_delta: Read and follow CLAUDE.md. Implement a general solution, never a Python-only or exact-reproduction special case. Write the failing regression oracle before implementation and run Ruff on changed files before committing.
context.structure: tldr structure: _check_hallucinations is src/fastedit/inference/chunked_merge.py:116-174; chunked_merge calls it in the model fallback around lines 833 and 842. The helper currently normalizes to stripped global sets, excludes every snippet line from anchors, and loses order/multiplicity.

environment.baseline: 864 passed, 24 skipped, 4 unrelated optional-MLX failures; 39 unrelated repository-wide Ruff findings

issue.confirmed_reproduction: The exact correct merge scores 0.0, triggers two model calls, rejects one chunk, and leaves the original unchanged.
issue.unsafe_suggestion: Do not use the issue proposal len(lost_anchors) <= len(snippet_new); it accepts additive edits that drop unrelated lines, one-to-many replacements that also drop a bystander, and duplicate output.

implementation_guidance: Make validation aware of ordered replacement correspondence or an equivalently sound edit explanation; global set/cardinality compensation is insufficient.
Preserve line order and multiplicity in validation.
Require intended new snippet code to land and reject unsupported output lines and leaked markers.
Allow only original lines that can be tied to the intended replacement to disappear; unrelated original lines must remain.
Reuse existing generic helpers or standard-library machinery where appropriate; add no dependency.
Keep the private helper signature stable unless a signature change is strictly necessary and escalated.
required_regressions: Exact issue #3 faithful one-line return replacement is accepted.
The faithful edit plus an unrelated deleted line is rejected.
A one-to-many intended replacement plus an unrelated bystander deletion is rejected.
An additive edit that drops an unrelated original line is rejected.
Duplicate supported lines are rejected when multiplicity is not intended.
Missing required snippet code is rejected.
Repeated identical original lines are handled by multiplicity rather than collapsed into a set.

bounds.test_command: uv run --with pytest python -m pytest -q tests/test_hallucination_validation.py
